def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    boxes=[]; small=[]
    for col in set(x for r in g for x in r)-{bg}:
        seen=[[False]*w for _ in range(h)]
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if g[i][j]==col and not seen[i][j]:
                    st=[(i,j)];seen[i][j]=True;comp=[]
                    while st:
                        y,x=st.pop();comp.append((y,x))
                        for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==col:
                                seen[ny][nx]=True;st.append((ny,nx))
                    if len(comp)>=3:
                        ys=[p[0] for p in comp];xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                        boxes.append((min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs),col))
                    else:
                        small+=comp
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for y0,y1,x0,x1,col in boxes:
        for y in range(y0,y1+1):
            for x in range(x0,x1+1): res[y][x]=col
    for y,x in small:
        if not any(y0<=y<=y1 and x0<=x<=x1 for y0,y1,x0,x1,c in boxes): res[y][x]=bg
    return res
